description: This file contains functions related to firmware upgrading and boot management for GL.iNet devices, including handling NAND and NOR flash upgrades and managing boot environments.

methods.name: glinet_using_boot_dev_switch
methods.description: Checks if the boot device switch is enabled by reading environment variable 'boot_dev'.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nand
methods.description: Sets the next boot to NAND by resetting boot count unless the boot device switch is on.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nor
methods.description: Sets the next boot to NOR by resetting boot count unless the boot device switch is on.

methods.name: glinet_nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines whether to perform NAND or NOR upgrade based on the magic number in the upgrade file.

methods.name: nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the actual upgrade process, handling both NOR and NAND flash based on file magic number and partition detection.
